card.name: Small words in stock label sentences
card.fires_on: Short words like "all", "the" or "information" inside set label phrases, e.g. "applies to all AEDs", "in the judgment of the physician, the potential benefit", "do not include all the information".

modes.label: Pregnancy benefit-risk clause
modes.description: The word "the" after "in the judgment of the physician," before benefit and risk wording.
modes.example: this drug should be used during pregnancy only if, in the judgment of the physician,<< the>> potential benefit justifies the potential risk to

modes.label: Class-wide risk statement
modes.description: The word "all" after "applies to" in the antiepileptic drug suicidality warning.
modes.example: suggests that the risk applies to<< all>> AEDs used for any indication.

modes.label: Highlights disclaimer
modes.description: The word "information" in "do not include all the information needed to use".
modes.example: These highlights do not include all the<< information>> needed to use Salicor™ safely
